body: this compiles on real loongarch64 machine, see https://github.com/AOSC-Dev/aosc-os-abbs/pull/12573

after consulting expert from loongson and benchmarking on my machine, my suggestion is use 16 to 64 `ibar 0` instead. the reason of use many `ibar` is simulate delay of x86 `pause` instruction, which is 140 cycles on recent machine.
